title: Binary search with lo, mid, hi pointers

steps.caption: The array is sorted, so one comparison can rule out half of it. lo and hi mark the window that may still hold 42. Right now it is everything.
Probe the middle: mid = (0 + 7) // 2 = 3, and a[3] = 21.
21 < 42, so 42 cannot be at index 3 or anywhere to its left. Dim those cells and move lo to mid + 1 = 4.
New window is cells 4 to 7. mid = (4 + 7) // 2 = 5, and a[5] = 35.
35 < 42 again. Dim cells 4 and 5, and move lo to 6. The window shrank from 8 cells to 2.
mid = (6 + 7) // 2 = 6, and a[6] = 42. Found in 3 probes. Each probe halves the window, so n cells need about log2(n) probes.
